name: MD Studio
author: Brett
description: A Markdown browser and editor for every .md file Brett works with, on the dock engine. A column lists the files in collapsible categories by scope (Project, Claude, Repo, Notes Vault) with an edit switch per file and its reference chain as branches; files open as dock tabs that float, split, resize and drop on any tab header or into a split. Preview, edit or split with live preview, a Markdown toolbar, find and replace, autosave, conflict-safe saves and version history with restore. Four views (Browse, Read, Write, IDE), snippets to drag in, wizards for Claude md files, and a context view with token counts per referenced part.

items.title: List Markdown files
items.description: Every .md file by scope (Project, Claude, Repo, Notes) and category. q filters by name or path; content=true also searches inside the files.

items.title: Read a Markdown file
items.description: One file by id (repo:<path>, hub:<project>/<path>, notes:<folder>/<name>.md): its text, version, token count and references.

items.title: Save a Markdown file
items.description: Write a file: {id, content, if_version}. if_version "" creates only; the version from read-file saves only if nobody changed it since. The replaced text is kept in the version history.

items.title: Read a kept version of a file
Context chain with token counts
items.description: A file and everything it references (imports, links, paths) as a tree, with about how many tokens each part costs and the total.

items.title: Open a file in MD Studio
items.description: Opens a Markdown file as a tab in the open console (args: an id or a path such as CLAUDE.md, notes/plans/x.md).
